newsitem.title: UK: Salomon gives BZW warning over F1 float - FT.
newsitem.headline: Salomon gives BZW warning over F1 float - FT.

text.p: Salomon Brothers, the U.S. investment bank planning to float the Formula One Holdings motor racing group, has given BZW, the British merchant bank, an ultimatum to stop advising on a rival plan, the Financial Times said on Wednesday.
BZW had been told to to stop giving advice to the plan by British Sky Broadcasting Plc or get off the team, the paper said.
BZW, a subsidiary of Barclays, is one of four global managers for the flotation, which Salomon hopes to launch in November.
But BZW is also advising BSkyB, Rupert Murdoch's satellite television company, on a proposal to take a minority stake in Formula One Holdings, which markets broadcasting rights for the sport.
Christian Purslow of Salomon demanded that BZW give assurances that none of the privileged information it had received would be passed on or used by a third party.
"If there's a conflict of interest, then they are out of the syndicate," Purslow was quoted as saying.
BZW declined to comment, the Financial Times said.
